findings.title: fetch_error_details misaligns error IDs with nodestore results
findings.body: fetch_error_details builds node_ids from error_ids, calls nodestore.backend.get_multi(node_ids), then does zip(error_ids, events.values()). get_multi returns a dict keyed by node_id with no ordering guarantee matching error_ids, and filters out misses, so values() order does not correspond to error_ids order. The consequence is error titles/messages/timestamps get attached to the wrong error id, producing incorrect error context in the Seer summarization request.

findings.title: get_merged_pr_single_issue_template calls _truncate_title on wrong class
findings.body: CommitContextIntegration defines _truncate_title but get_merged_pr_single_issue_template calls PRCommentWorkflow._truncate_title(title). PRCommentWorkflow does not define that helper, so rendering a merged-PR suspect-issues comment raises AttributeError. The consequence is GitHub/GitLab PR comment workflows crash when formatting the issue list instead of posting the comment.

findings.title: Browser report age/timestamp exclusivity check uses truthiness
findings.body: validate_timestamp checks self.initial_data.get("age") and validate_age checks self.initial_data.get("timestamp"). A value of 0 is falsy, so a report with timestamp=0 and age present, or age=0 and timestamp present, passes validation when the specs require them to be mutually exclusive. The consequence is invalid mixed-spec reports are accepted and valid edge-case reports can be misclassified.

findings.title: Table widget visualization discards real query results
findings.body: When organization.features includes use-table-widget-visualization, tableResultComponent renders TableWidgetVisualization with hardcoded empty columns=[] and empty tableData data:[]/meta instead of the fetched result, fields, and metadata used by the legacy table path. The consequence is dashboards show an empty table with no rows or headers when the flag is on, a data-loss regression.
